coverage.name: Navigation and shared UI

coverage.name: Items

coverage.name: Categories

coverage.name: Units

coverage.name: Item routing and eligibility

coverage.name: Party Master

coverage.name: Party child details

coverage.name: Party settings

coverage.name: Sale Invoices

coverage.name: Invoice payments
coverage.currentFlow: Optionally save initial payment; later record payment from invoice detail; server history reloads.

coverage.name: Invoice print/PDF templates

coverage.name: Purchase Orders
coverage.currentFlow: Supplier and item rows -> save PO -> approve into Sent from physical panel -> receive against original lines -> convert/link draft bill.

coverage.name: Purchase Bills
coverage.currentFlow: Create supplier bill directly or through PO conversion; optionally allocate accepted receipts while draft; confirm financial record.

coverage.name: Bill-to-receipt allocation
coverage.currentFlow: Match bill lines to original accepted receipt lines while draft; avoid receiving the same stock twice.

coverage.name: Purchase Returns
coverage.currentFlow: Standalone return form chooses supplier and optional linked bill, then enters return lines/reason. Physical receipt returns are also available in PO detail.

coverage.name: Supplier Payments
coverage.currentFlow: Pick supplier, record amount/mode/date/reference, optionally add bill allocation rows; allocated amount must not exceed payment.

coverage.name: Expenses

coverage.name: Expense Categories

coverage.name: Purchase Reports
coverage.currentFlow: Select report tab, dates/filters, run report.

coverage.name: Purchase Follow-ups
coverage.currentFlow: See current pending accepted quantities and drill to PO; performance uses receipt period and separates base units.

coverage.name: Rojmel Dashboard
coverage.currentFlow: Cash snapshot excludes transfers from profit/loss.

coverage.name: Transactions

coverage.name: Rojmel Reports
